content_blocks.title: Reference example: Data and Expiration Problems
content_blocks.code:
TYPE demo:key
TTL demo:key
SCAN 0 MATCH demo:* COUNT 20
content_blocks.expected_output: Returns a type, remaining TTL (or -1/-2 where applicable), and a cursor/key page.
content_blocks.run_instructions: SCAN COUNT is a hint; continue while the cursor is non-zero and do not assume one page is complete.
content_blocks.reset_steps: Read-only inspection; no key is created.
content_blocks.note: Use a disposable development keyspace. Treat this as a learning example, not a production-ready policy without boundary tests.
